title: Movement beyond the Mirage
content:
Pristine, orderly, sublime majestic odour  
Exquisite beauty that pulls me over  
Vibrance layered to cross me over  
if so, why do it in parts; do it all over?

Who are you, I ask restlessly  
Creator his expression or random symphony  
Why pull my existence  
when all about you is translucence.

A laughable choice - world, me & god  
That's the illusion, of choice we trod  
Today it's me, you & a mirage  
Mirage at its peak resembles you & lacks no part

order, stillness & dissolution - paths you opened up -  
the movement beyond the mirage  
the path looks open & clear  
to see beyond the mirage
